{{Quote|We are en route to intercept a Republic cruiser carrying supplies and reinforcements to the Foundry.|Moff Phennir|<ref name="TOR:CtA">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Call to Arms|the ''White Nova''}}</ref>}}
The '''''Dorin's Sky''''' was a [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] that was in the service of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Dorin's Sky'' was a standard [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|Once the cruiser is captured, you can use it to slip past the Republic defenses and infiltrate the Foundry itself.|Moff Phennir|<ref name="TOR:CtA" />}}
During the Cold War, the ''Dorin's Sky'' was carrying supplies to the ancient space station the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]] that had been taken over by the Republic after the release of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] as part of the Republic fleet sent to guard it against Imperial attack. During this time it was carrying a battalion of [[Republic trooper]]s and as well as a team of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to reinforce the station when the warship was intercepted by the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] [[White Nova (Harrower-class)|''White Nova'']], the command ship of an Imperial task force. Once captured by the ''White Nova''{{'s}} tractor beam, an Imperial strike team entered the warship and took the ship after eliminating the Republic forces in command of it. The ship would be later used to bypass the Republic blockade and board the Foundry prior to the arrival of the ''White Nova'' and the rest of the Imperial Task Force.
